name: Netspeed
summary: Canberra ISP founded c.1994; acquired Velocity Internet (2010) and Apex Telecom (2012); both NetSpeed and Velocity traded under ByteCard Pty Ltd. Retired from retail internet c.Jan 2024; website reduced to webmail-only while sibling brand Velocity continued.

events.details: NetSpeed Communications established in Canberra. Legal entity later operated as ByteCard Pty Ltd (ACN 052 315 812); trading name 'Netspeed Internet Communications' registered Sep 2005.

Ceased offering retail internet between 22 Dec 2023 and 30 Jan 2024: netspeed.com.au was replaced by a webmail-only portal with the Join/Plans navigation commented out of the page and a fresh 'Copyright 2024'; the Critical Information Summary directory later returned 404 (CIS documents are mandatory for RSPs selling plans). Owner ByteCard Pty Ltd continues via the surviving Velocity Internet brand. No public customer-migration announcement found.
